decisions.reason: Confirming the competitor reference URL does not change the Smash Room brand name or identity.
The confirmed design reference does not change the requirement to provide location sublinks or their routing behavior.
Identifying the competitor reference site does not change the requirement to support integration of future locations.
The design-reference confirmation does not alter Wix as the booking platform or any booking-system behavior.
The source decision does not change independent tracking of bookings, revenue, or sales by location.
Confirming a visual design reference does not change the master site's role of consolidating brand, location, and business information.
